responsibility: This header collects the public function prototypes and externally visible scheduling attributes for the m68k backend. It declares operand printers, move and compare output helpers, address legitimacy and PIC/TLS helpers, reload hooks, prologue/epilogue expansion, return-value logic, scheduling attribute callbacks, and other target hooks implemented mainly in m68k.cc and aux-output support code. It is the interface layer used by macros, machine descriptions, and generated code to call into the m68k target implementation.
